# Pravine Mani

> Toronto engineer building lead-response systems, marketing automation, and SEO + GEO in code. Every inbound lead answered in seconds, qualified, routed, and logged, with the code owned outright by the client. Most current work is patient and lead acquisition for clinics, training companies, and local service businesses. Independent consultancy since February 2026. Fixed scope, fixed price, milestone-refund guarantee.

## Overview

Pravine Mani runs a one-person consultancy in Toronto, Canada. Three focus areas: marketing automation (lead pipelines, lifecycle email, CRM wiring), AI workflows (Claude Code, MCP servers, agent systems, voice agents), and programmatic SEO + GEO (Schema.org, llms.txt, AI-search citability). McMaster Computer Engineering & Management graduate. Engineering background at Ericsson (5G, Go, gRPC), Imprimo, and Fixvi. Reference systems in production: an AI voice agent handling 700+ dental leads across 7 Toronto clinics, and a training-company SEO rebuild that grew search impressions 5.3x in four months.

## Focus Areas

- [Marketing automation](https://pravinemani.com/services/marketing-automation/): Lead pipelines. Lifecycle email. CRM + webhook wiring. Stripe subscriptions. Vercel + Resend + Supabase, no platform fee.
- [AI workflows](https://pravinemani.com/services/ai/): Custom workflows. MCP servers. Agent and voice-agent systems. Prompt + eval suites. Code-first on Claude Code + Vercel.
- [SEO + GEO](https://pravinemani.com/services/seo/): Programmatic SEO at scale. Schema.org structured data. AI-search visibility (llms.txt + passage citability). Local SEO.

## Engagement Shapes

- [Scoping Call](https://pravinemani.com/services/#scoping-call): Free 30-minute call. Written quote within 24 hours when there is a fit.
- [Pilot Build](https://pravinemani.com/services/#pilot): One working piece of your workflow on your real data, in about 2 days. $750 flat, credited toward a Sprint.
- [Build Sprint](https://pravinemani.com/services/#sprint): Complete production build of one workflow, fixed scope and price. From $2,500. Named fixed-price sprints: GEO / AI-search $2,500 (3 days), MCP server $3,500 (5 days), programmatic SEO $4,500 (7 days), lead pipeline $4,500 (7 days).
- [Custom Build](https://pravinemani.com/services/#custom): Multi-workflow systems. Quoted on scope, milestone-paid, 30 days of post-launch fixes.
- [Ops Retainer](https://pravinemani.com/services/#retainer): Post-ship only. Keep-it-running $1,500/mo or growth ops $3,000/mo.
- Guarantee: every contract carries a milestone-refund clause. Miss an agreed milestone and that milestone is refunded.

## Case Studies

- [Orbit Dental AI: patient acquisition](https://pravinemani.com/work/case-studies/orbit/): Marketing site, lead dashboard, and "Anna," a dual-channel AI voice + SMS agent (Vapi, Claude, Deepgram, ElevenLabs) that answers, qualifies, and books every new lead in seconds. In production since June 2026: 700+ leads in the pipeline across 7 clinics, 1,100+ SMS in a single week, 30-50 leads/day intake, CASL/CRTC/PHIPA compliance enforced in code.
- [CISNET: IT certification training, site + SEO rebuild](https://pravinemani.com/work/case-studies/cisnet/): Migrated a Toronto IT training company off legacy PHP onto Next.js 16 with 200+ programmatic SEO pages, 70+ individually mapped redirects, and a custom admin portal. Measured in Google Search Console: monthly impressions 5.3x in four months (4,808 to 25,639), ranking pages 27 to 145, flagship CCNA page position 44.5 to 19.5 in one month with impressions up 30x, position 1 for "cloud computing classes near me."

## Proof

- [Proof Library](https://pravinemani.com/proof-library/): Real artifacts from the systems: a full campaign build (ad to SMS to voice agent to booking) and mapped lead pipelines with failure states and per-run costs.
- [Speed-to-lead calculator](https://pravinemani.com/tools/speed-to-lead/): Free calculator estimating the monthly revenue cost of slow lead response.
